description: Infrastructure & docs wiring for the ML service: Docker Compose service, Helm ml-service Deployment+Service+values (with a new _helpers fullname), a third Terraform ECR repo, a GitHub Actions CD step to build/push the ml-service image, and README Phase 3 completion + tech stack/env/endpoint/secret updates. Runtime/artifacts reference FEAT-001's ml-service image; the config files themselves validate independently (docker compose config, helm lint/template, terraform fmt).
steps: Modify docker-compose.yml: add an `ml-service` service after `frontend` — `build: ./ml-service`, `ports: ["8000:8000"]`, `environment: ML_SERVICE_PORT=8000`, `depends_on: [backend]`. Keep the existing postgres/redis/backend/frontend services and the pgdata volume unchanged.

Modify helm/truckbiz/templates/_helpers.tpl: add a `truckbiz.mlServiceFullname` helper that mirrors `truckbiz.backendFullname` (printf "%s-ml-service" (include "truckbiz.fullname" .) | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-").

Create helm/truckbiz/templates/ml-service/deployment.yaml: Deployment for the ML service using .Values.mlService (image repository:tag, pullPolicy, replicaCount, containerPort from .Values.mlService.service.targetPort, readinessProbe & livenessProbe httpGet path / port 8000, resources, securityContext.runAsNonRoot). Mirror the structure/labels of templates/backend/deployment.yaml (use the mlServiceFullname helper and component label `ml-service`).

Create helm/truckbiz/templates/ml-service/service.yaml: ClusterIP Service on port 8000 using .Values.mlService.service, mirroring templates/backend/service.yaml (mlServiceFullname helper, component label `ml-service`).

Modify helm/truckbiz/values.yaml: add an `mlService` section after `frontend` — image.{repository: "YOUR_ECR_REPO.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/truckbiz-ml-service", tag: latest, pullPolicy: IfNotPresent}, replicaCount: 2, service.{type: ClusterIP, port: 8000, targetPort: 8000}, resources.{requests:{cpu:100m, memory:256Mi}, limits:{cpu:500m, memory:512Mi}}, securityContext.{runAsNonRoot:true, allowPrivilegeEscalation:false}, readinessProbe.{httpGet:{path:/, port:8000}, initialDelaySeconds:10, periodSeconds:5}, livenessProbe.{httpGet:{path:/, port:8000}, initialDelaySeconds:30, periodSeconds:10}.
Modify helm/truckbiz/values-dev.yaml: add `mlService` override — image.tag: dev-latest, replicaCount: 1, resources.{requests:{cpu:50m, memory:128Mi}, limits:{cpu:250m, memory:256Mi}}.
Modify helm/truckbiz/values-prod.yaml: add `mlService` override — image.tag: prod-latest, replicaCount: 2, resources.{requests:{cpu:200m, memory:512Mi}, limits:{cpu:1000m, memory:1Gi}}.

Modify terraform/modules/ecr/main.tf: add a third resource `aws_ecr_repository.ml_service` (name = "${var.app_name}-ml-service", image_tag_mutability = "MUTABLE", scan_on_push = true, tags) and an `aws_ecr_lifecycle_policy.ml_service` (keep last 10 images, identical shape to the backend/frontend ones). Keep the existing backend/frontend resources unchanged.
Modify terraform/modules/ecr/outputs.tf: add `output "ecr_ml_service_repo_url" { description = "ML service ECR repo URL"; value = aws_ecr_repository.ml_service.repository_url }`.

Modify .github/workflows/cd.yml: add a new step 'Build & push ml-service image' (after the frontend build step) mirroring the backend/frontend steps — env ECR_REGISTRY, ML_SERVICE_REPO: ${{ secrets.ECR_ML_SERVICE_REPO }}, IMAGE_TAG; docker build -t ... -t ...:latest ./ml-service; push both tags. Extend the 'Update Helm values with new image tags' step's yq run to also set `.mlService.image.repository = "$ECR_REGISTRY/$ML_SERVICE_REPO"` and `.mlService.image.tag = "$IMAGE_TAG"` in values-${ENV}.yaml (add the ML_SERVICE_REPO to that step's env too).

Modify README.md: (a) Tech Stack table — add a row 'ML Service | Python 3.12, FastAPI, scikit-learn, joblib, Uvicorn'. (b) Project Structure block — add `├── ml-service/   # Python FastAPI ML prediction microservice`. (c) API Endpoints table — add the prediction routes (GET /api/predictions/rate, GET /api/predictions/fuel/:market, GET /api/predictions/fuel-cost, GET /api/predictions/demand/:market, POST /api/predictions/demand/forecast — all Auth ✓, proxied to the ML service). (d) Environment Variables — add backend `ML_SERVICE_URL` (default http://localhost:8000) and ml-service `ML_SERVICE_PORT`/`BACKEND_URL`. (e) Docker section services list — add 'ML Service: http://localhost:8000'. (f) Required GitHub Secrets table — add `ECR_ML_SERVICE_REPO | ECR repository name for ML service image`. (g) Phase Roadmap — change '🔮 Phase 3 — ML Predictions' to '✅ Phase 3 — ML Predictions' and rewrite bullets as delivered: GradientBoosting rate predictor (USA/Europe synthetic lane data with confidence intervals), 7-day lane demand forecast, demand heatmap (top 15 lanes), fuel cost estimator with simulated live diesel pricing, FastAPI microservice + JWT-protected backend proxy. Preserve the '© 2026 TruckBiz' copyright.
acceptance_criteria: `docker compose config >/dev/null` exits 0 and the ml-service service is present.

`helm lint helm/truckbiz` reports 0 failures; `helm template truckbiz ./helm/truckbiz -f helm/truckbiz/values.yaml -f helm/truckbiz/values-dev.yaml >/dev/null` exits 0 and renders an ml-service Deployment + Service.
`helm template` with values-prod.yaml renders the ml-service Deployment with 2 replicas; with values-dev.yaml 1 replica.
`terraform fmt -check terraform/modules/ecr/main.tf terraform/modules/ecr/outputs.tf` reports no diff (files are formatted).
.github/workflows/cd.yml contains a 'Build & push ml-service image' step and yq lines setting `.mlService.image.repository`/`.tag`; its YAML is valid (parses with pyyaml in a throwaway venv).
README.md contains '✅ Phase 3 — ML Predictions' and references 'ml-service' in the tech stack and Docker services list; the required-secrets table lists ECR_ML_SERVICE_REPO.
verification: Run `docker compose config >/dev/null` and confirm exit code 0.
Run `helm lint helm/truckbiz` and confirm '0 chart(s) failed'.

Run `helm template truckbiz ./helm/truckbiz -f helm/truckbiz/values.yaml -f helm/truckbiz/values-dev.yaml 2>&1 | grep -c 'kind: Deployment'` is >=3 and `... | grep -i 'ml-service'` shows the ml-service resources render.

Run `helm template truckbiz ./helm/truckbiz -f helm/truckbiz/values.yaml -f helm/truckbiz/values-prod.yaml 2>&1 | grep -A4 'name: .*ml-service'` and confirm 2 replicas in the dev render via `grep -c 'replicas: 1'` on the dev template output.
Run `terraform fmt -check terraform/modules/ecr/main.tf terraform/modules/ecr/outputs.tf` and confirm exit code 0 (no diff).
Run `grep -n 'aws_ecr_repository.ml_service' terraform/modules/ecr/main.tf` and `grep -n 'ecr_ml_service_repo_url' terraform/modules/ecr/outputs.tf` to confirm both present.

Validate cd.yml YAML: `python3 -m venv /tmp/ylc && /tmp/ylc/bin/pip install -q pyyaml && /tmp/ylc/bin/python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/cd.yml'))"` exits 0; and `grep -n 'Build & push ml-service' .github/workflows/cd.yml` shows the new step; and `grep -n 'mlService.image' .github/workflows/cd.yml` shows the yq lines.
Run `grep -c '✅ Phase 3 — ML Predictions' README.md` -> 1; `grep -c 'ECR_ML_SERVICE_REPO' README.md` -> >=1; `grep -c 'ml-service' README.md` -> >=1.
